title: Freelance Invoice Cashflow Feed Freshness Gap
dataSources: Invoices (`freelance:invoice`), billed hours (`freelance:hours`), tax estimates (`freelance:tax`), client pipeline records (`freelance:lead`), project health (`freelance:project`).
app: Freelance invoices, billed-hours exports, quarterly tax estimates, and client-pipeline updates streamed to Splunk HEC via accounting APIs, spreadsheets, and CRM forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=freelance:invoice
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by client
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>72
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects source feeds or counterparties that have stopped producing freelance invoice cashflow events inside the expected ingestion window.
value: Financial blind spots often start with a broken import, so freshness monitoring protects every report built on top of the feed.
implementation: Tune the freshness threshold to how often your invoicing, billing, or pipeline data should refresh.
visualization: Table of client values by hours since the last event.
grandmaExplanation: It maps when the stream for freelance invoice cashflow has gone stale and might hide missing records.
